['DHL Group '].company_description: DHL Group is a German multinational package delivery and supply chain management company. It is one of the world's largest courier companies and operates in over 220 countries and territories. The company is a successor to the German mail authority Deutsche Bundespost and offers services in both postal and parcel divisions. The postal division, Deutsche Post, delivers millions of letters each day in Germany, while the parcel division, DHL, provides international courier and express mail services. DHL Group is listed on the Börse Frankfurt and is part of the Euro Stoxx 50 stock market index.

['Robert Bosch GmbH '].company_description: Robert Bosch GmbH, commonly known as Bosch, is a German multinational engineering and technology company. It operates in four business sectors: mobility, consumer goods, industrial technology, and energy and building technology. Bosch is the largest automotive supplier in the world.
